regulation_clause.text: A card account may be reported past-due to CICs or levied penal charges only when past due for more than three days; days-past-due and late charges are computed from the payment due date; late charges apply only to the outstanding amount after the due date, not the Total Amount Due.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 23(5) requires late charges to apply only to the outstanding amount after the due date, not the Total Amount Due (charge_base= outstanding_after_due_date). 2000-ASSESS computes WS-LATE-CHARGE from WS-TOTAL-AMT-DUE (line 28), the opposite basis; WS-OUTSTANDING-AMT is accepted as input (line 12/20) but never referenced in the calculation. The 3-day grace comparator itself (line 26, > 3) is correct.
